items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: after Boots, who became my girlfriend while I was there

ctx.x: But she went by the name Boots Castle. I'm getting ahead of myself here. And discovering that it was music, she guided me to the Reno Club and said after 12 o'clock the band starts, it was Monday morning, and little did I know, that they had what they called a breakfast dance.
Where was this Reno Club? Do you remember the street?
